title: sedimentingCentrifuge operation
description: A sedimenting centrifuge by Sigma theory on the case's size grid. Model tubularBowl: Sigma = w^2 V / (g ln(2 r2^2/(r1^2 + r2^2))) (Ambler 1959 eqs. 24-28; de Haan et al. eqs. 9.44-9.46), Geankoplis's half-layer D_pc beside it. Model discStack: Sigma = 2 pi n w^2 (r2^3 - r1^3)/(3 g tan theta) (de Haan et al. eq. 9.52; Ambler eq. 46, C = 1). The cut size d50 = sqrt(9 mu Q/(drho g Sigma)); Stokes' window enforced (Re < 1 at the cut size). The grade efficiency per class is derived here, not printed by any source. Inlet in, outlets (sediment centrate).
